New 'E20 Janta Party' Emerges Demanding 100% Petrol Option

A new group, the 'E20 Janta Party', has launched a protest demanding consumer choice for 100% petrol and the resignation of Transport Minister Nitin Gadkari. The party advocates for transparent fuel labelling and is supported by transporters planning a march to Parliament against E20 blended fuel. This movement follows earlier protests by the Citizen for Justice and Peace (CJP). Some coverage also notes commentary from public figures regarding the protests.
